---
title: "Analytics modeling, from scratch"
subtitle: "Fourteen methods, each explained as a short essay with figures you can move."
engine: knitr
---

Every chapter starts from a question and builds one modeling idea from the ground up: the problem the method solves, the formula that carries it, and the judgment calls that matter when the math meets messy data. The figures are computed in your browser, so you can drag a point or slide a parameter and watch the answer change. The R that produces every plot is at the end of each chapter.
